title: Serialize supported writers and return busy at timeout
preconditions: Use a temporary Saga directory and one writer holding its Saga lock until explicitly released.

steps.action: Attempt a second WithSagaLock callback with 40ms timeout while first holds the lock.
steps.expected_result: It reports timeout no earlier than 40ms; the blocking writer completes after release.

steps.action: Start eight callbacks that count active writers while acquiring the same Saga lock.
steps.expected_result: Maximum simultaneous active callbacks is exactly one.

steps.action: Repeat with two real supported mutations and inspect final public query state plus the contending busy error.
steps.expected_result: No persisted mutation is interleaved; the contending public error identifies Saga busy.

expected_result: Cooperating writers cannot mutate the Saga concurrently.
